name: zeroapi
description: ZeroAPI - transparent subscription-aware model and account routing for OpenClaw

compat.notes: Model/provider hooks are tested with OpenClaw 2026.5.2, 2026.9.1, 2026.9.3 and reviewed pinned source. Auth-profile preferences use the public session API for existing JSON/SQLite sessions; the native hook supports only model/provider overrides and does not guarantee same-turn account switching. See references/openclaw-compatibility.md for exact source pins and test limits.
